external_optional.title: Optional external seven-eighths transfer
external_optional.statement_contract: Under a genuinely proved and compatible import of the pinned external ordinary-zeta nonvanishing theorem for Re(s)>7/8, derive the native ceiling Theta<=3/8, and for every fixed native source order d and epsilon>3/8 derive finite positive-damped L2 energy. This is a bounded zero-free improvement, not any terminal Path A/B/C/D closure.
external_optional.native_source_scope: Actual Mathlib riemannZeta and actual native displacement supremum, with the native reflection/source adapter. No family-specific Hecke probe is silently identified with the native one-copy prime field.

statement_components.formula: Actual nontrivial-zero reflection plus this strict right-strip exclusion gives Theta<=3/8. Integrability is asserted for epsilon>3/8 only; no boundary epsilon=3/8 or all-epsilon conclusion follows.

The ordinary Dirichlet L companion retains its principal-pole exclusion. The zeta root uses ordinary Mathlib riemannZeta, including that library’s pole convention; it is not an ordinate-bounded or renamed object.

evidence_origin.compatibility_note: The inherited external proof used Lean 4.34.1; native PR294 uses its frozen Lean 4.33.0-rc2 toolchain. A compatible full proof/adapter is required. Do not change the parent toolchain or add an axiom to bypass this obligation.

forbidden_substitutions: No iteration of 7/8 to 1/2 without a new improvement theorem.
No all-height native arithmetic estimate from a family-specific external detector without exact transport.
No claim that the external source is already imported into this native build.
No project axiom, signature-only surrogate or parent-toolchain replacement.
No promotion of historical receipts to a fresh external rebuild.
